chapters.title: Can Copilot replace Power BI developers?
Complex data models as breaking point

takeaways: Copilot in Power BI wins on speed, producing visuals and simple DAX measures in seconds, but its output needs validation.
In complex models with multiple fact tables, many-to-many joins and time intelligence, Copilot's guessed relationships and measures can produce plausible but wrong numbers.
Developers still provide business context, accurate modeling and dashboard storytelling, so the best approach combines Copilot for drafts with human validation.
hook: Can Copilot build Power BI data models, DAX measures and dashboards as well as a trained developer? This head-to-head comparison is for Power BI developers and analysts worried about being replaced and shows where Copilot speeds up work and where human judgment remains essential.
